models.name: ecommerce_customers
models.description: Customer accounts with email and password credentials for authentication, including email verification tracking. Tracks suspension status for account management. Email is the primary authentication identity, with secure password hashing. Customer accounts require email verification before full access to platform features.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's email address, used for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt. Never stored in plaintext.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether customer's email has been verified. Required before full platform access.

plainFields.name: is_suspended
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer account is suspended. Suspended accounts cannot log in.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was marked for deletion (soft delete). Never physically deleted from database.

models.name: ecommerce_customer_sessions
models.description:
Session tokens for customer authentication with JWT access/refresh tokens and 30-minute inactivity timeout. Includes connection metadata for security auditing and session tracking. Each session belongs to a customer and expires after 30 minutes of inactivity.

The expired_at field enforces 30-minute timeout security constraint, preventing session hijacking. Session data is automatically cleaned up with a background job when expired_at is reached.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Page URL from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Previous page URL that led to session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was last updated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session expires (30 minutes after creation, security enforcement).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens with expiration for customer account registration, used during new account creation to confirm email ownership. Includes tokens, expiration times, and customer reference for authentication flow.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's {@link ecommerce_customers.id whose email is being verified.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Randomly generated verification token.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Token creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Token last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for expired tokens.

models.name: ecommerce_customer_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with expiration and binding to customer accounts.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer account's {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token used to verify password reset request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset token expires.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: When a password reset token was successfully used for password change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the password reset token was marked as deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_sellers
models.description: Registered seller accounts with email/password credentials and pending approval status. Seller accounts require administrator approval before they can list products for sale. This table serves as the canonical identity record for sellers with its own authentication flow and business logic.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for identification, authentication, and communication. Should be a valid email format and unique across all seller accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the seller's password stored using bcrypt with minimum 8 characters complexity constraint. Cannot be null and must be generated during registration or password reset.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Business name of the seller (e.g., 'ABC Wholesale'), shown publicly on product listings. Optional field but recommended.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Brief description of the seller business (e.g., 'We offer quality electronics since 2010'), shown on seller profile. Optional field with maximum 500 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current approval status of the seller. Allowed values: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'. Must be initialized to 'pending' upon registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller's account details were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was marked for deletion (soft delete implementation). Nullable as it indicates whether the account is active or not.

models.name: ecommerce_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access/refresh tokens for seller authentication, including connection metadata and expiry times for security. Serves as session management for seller identity verification.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account's {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used for this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL reference (current page) when login occurred.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer (previous page) when login occurred.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When this session expires (not earlier than when it was created).

models.name: ecommerce_seller_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens with expiration for seller registration, used to validate seller accounts during onboarding. Contains unique tokens linked to seller accounts with expiration timestamps and verification status.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account associated with this verification token. {@link ecommerce_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to seller's email for registration.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification token expires.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the verification record was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_seller_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for seller accounts with expiration timestamps and binding to specific seller account.

- Securely generated tokens (32-64 characters) for authentication flow.
- Expiration set to 15 minutes after creation for security.
- Relationship established with seller accounts (1:N).

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller's account ID. {@link ecommerce_sellers.id.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Securely generated token for resetting password, unique per request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token expires (15 minutes after creation).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when password reset token was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the password reset token.

models.name: ecommerce_admins
models.description: Admin accounts with email/password credentials and admin role permissions

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account details were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_admin_sessions
models.description:
Session tokens for administrative authentication with JWT tokens, IP tracking, navigation context, and 30-minute timeout. Captures login context for audit and security monitoring.

Session tokens in this table belong to administrative accounts (managed by 'ecommerce_admins' table) and are used for API authentication. Each session records login IP, navigation referrer, and token expiration for security purposes.

Multiple sessions per admin are allowed for concurrent logins (e.g., multiple devices), but sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Associated administrator's account. {@link ecommerce_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used during login for security monitoring.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Navigation URL provided after login for session tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referral source for session initiation (e.g., Google Chrome web client).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session expires for security.

models.name: ecommerce_admin_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for admin accounts (no email verification needed). Each token has an expiration timestamp and is tied to a specific admin account. Tokens expire after 30 minutes for security.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account associated with this password reset token.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: The actual password reset token used for verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token expires.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset token was used to reset password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset entry was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: ecommerce_admin_audit_logs
models.description:
Audit trail of all administrative actions, capturing before/after state for accountability and dispute resolution. Stores actions performed by admin users on other entities.

This table is strictly a subsidiary table for admin accounts, managing audit history through a 1:many relationship with `ecommerce_admins`. It captures complete state information before and after changes for transparent dispute resolution.

All audit entries are immutable and never deleted - only marked for soft deletion when necessary for data retention policy.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who performed the action. {@link ecommerce_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of admin action performed (create, update, delete, suspend, unsuspend, promote, demote).

plainFields.name: action_details
plainFields.description: Additional details about the action performed, if any.

plainFields.name: target_entity
plainFields.description: Entity name this action was applied to (e.g., 'ecommerce_products', 'ecommerce_sellers').

plainFields.name: old_state
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of entity state before the action (for audit purposes).

plainFields.name: new_state
plainFields.description: JSON string representation of entity state after the action (for audit purposes).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the audit entry was created (timestamp) for tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the audit entry was last updated (timestamp).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the audit entry was deleted (timestamp for soft delete) if applicable.

models.name: ecommerce_products
models.description: Core product listings with name, description, category ID, and base price. Products are declared by sellers and visible to customers. Each product belongs to a single category (with subcategories supported through the categories hierarchy).

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Category this product belongs to. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name (minimum 5 characters).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description (minimum 10 characters).

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product (minimum $0.01).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of product creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last product update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of product deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_product_snapshots
models.description:
Product snapshots for change history tracking.

Contains immutable historical state of product records including all fields.
Captures full state at the time of product editing for audit and dispute resolution.
Snapshots are retained permanently regardless of product deletion.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being snapped. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the product at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description of the product at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: category_id
plainFields.description: Category ID of the product at snapshot time. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was last updated (should be same as created_at for immutable snapshot).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was logically deleted for audit purposes (never used).

models.name: ecommerce_product_variants
models.description: SKU-specific product variants with their option values and variant-specific pricing. Each variant belongs to one product and allows price overrides for specific options. Requires independent management by sellers for inventory and pricing control.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this variant belongs to. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code for the variant (e.g., 'RED-LARGE').

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Variant-specific price (overrides product base price; null means use product's base price).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the variant was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the variant was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the variant was soft-deleted (null if currently active).

models.name: ecommerce_variant_snapshots
models.description: Snapshot of product variant modifications. Captures SKU, option values, price, stock, and timestamps for historical tracking. Preserves complete state for audit trails and dispute resolution as per platform requirements.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Variant being snapshotted. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: SKU identifier (unique within product variants).

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Variant-specific price at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: stock
plainFields.description: Stock quantity of variant at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created (for audit purposes).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this snapshot.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was soft-deleted (null if not deleted).

models.name: ecommerce_product_images
models.description:
Stores multiple image files for each product with ordering metadata.

Images can be uploaded by sellers for product listings. Each product can have multiple images.
Images can be reordered (position), and the first image is marked as the main/thumbnail image.

All images are stored via URL references, not file data. 
Images are included in the product snapshots for historical reference.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product this image belongs to. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL to the image file (stored in cloud storage).

plainFields.name: is_main
plainFields.description: Whether this image is the main thumbnail for the product.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Position of the image in the product gallery (0=first, 1=second, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was added.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was soft-deleted (null if not deleted).

models.name: ecommerce_product_image_snaps
models.description: Immutable historical record of image changes for product listings, capturing all modifications with before/after values. Preserves image metadata for audit and dispute resolution. Each snapshot corresponds to a specific product image modification.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_image_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product image being snapped. {@link ecommerce_product_images.id}

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User who triggered the image change. {@link actors.id}

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the image snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: old_url
plainFields.description: Previous image URL before modification.

plainFields.name: new_url
plainFields.description: New image URL after modification.

models.name: ecommerce_categories
models.description:
Category hierarchy with one-level subcategories. Root categories have no parent. Managed exclusively by administrators. Used for product categorization and browsing by customers.

Categories are organized as a parent-child hierarchy with only one level of subcategories. Root categories are displayed at top level and may have child categories. Each category has a name and optional description. Category hierarchy supports product browsing by customer, where they can filter products by category or subcategory.

Admins manage categories through the administrator interface, with a dedicated category management feature. The category structure persists across the platform for product listing and search.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to parent category. May be null for root categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name (e.g., 'Electronics', 'Clothing'). Maximum 50 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Category description (e.g., 'All electronic devices and accessories'). Maximum 255 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when category was soft-deleted. Nullable to support soft delete.

models.name: ecommerce_category_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable history of category name and description changes, capturing point-in-time states for audit trails. Records all category fields at the time of modification with timestamp and versioning.

**Key Business Context:**
- Preserves full category state history for administrators
- Required to satisfy 'Snapshot Principle Implementation' in Functional Requirements
- All category field modifications (name, description) trigger a new snapshot
- Used for dispute resolution in category management
- Preserves historical context even after category deletion

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_category_id
foreignFields.description: The category this snapshot belongs to. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name at the time of snapshot creation

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Category description at the time of snapshot creation

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when snapshot was created

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the underlying category was last modified

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of logical deletion (soft delete)

models.name: ecommerce_product_category_links
models.description: Junction table linking products to categories with explicit ordering. Each product can belong to multiple categories and each category can contain multiple products. The 'order' field indicates the position of the category in the product's category listing (e.g., main category, secondary category).

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product to which this category link belongs. {@link ecommerce_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category to which this product link belongs. {@link ecommerce_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: order
plainFields.description: The position of this category in the product's category list. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (first category = primary).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for records no longer active.

models.name: ecommerce_variant_inventories
models.description:
Tracks inventory quantity changes including restocking, order deductions, and adjustments with detailed reasons and timestamps. Each record represents a specific inventory transaction with quantities and reasons.

This table serves as the historical ledger for variant inventory changes and is managed exclusively through variant management operations. It does not require standalone CRUD endpoints but is accessed via variant detail APIs.

- References: ecommerce_product_variants, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant for which inventory was adjusted. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Net change in inventory quantity (positive for restocking, negative for orders/adjustments).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the inventory adjustment (e.g., 'order', 'restock', 'manual adjustment').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the inventory adjustment was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the inventory adjustment was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the inventory adjustment record was deleted (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_product_variant_options
models.description: Normalized key-value storage for variant options (e.g., color, size) to replace JSON string field in product variants. Each option is a key-value pair representing variant attributes like color or size. Ensures 1NF compliance by converting transitive dependencies into separate table records.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_product_variants_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the product variant this option belongs to. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Option key (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Must match a valid variant option type.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option value (e.g., 'red', 'large'). Corresponds to the key.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null if not deleted).

models.name: ecommerce_variant_snapshot_option_values

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_variant_snapshot_id
foreignFields.description: Link to the parent variant snapshot's {@link ecommerce_variant_snapshots.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Name of the option (e.g., 'color', 'size'). Must be a normalized key from product variant options.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value of the option (e.g., 'red', 'L'). Matches the option key's context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the option value was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_orders
models.description:
Main order records with order details, status, and customer reference. Each order represents a collection of purchased items from one or more sellers, created after successful payment to reflect accurate purchase history. Status is computed from individual order items' statuses (paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, partially completed) and stored for quick business reporting.

- Works with ecommerce_order_items for item-level details
- References ecommerce_customers for customer identity
- References ecommerce_customer_addresses for shipping locations

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: shipping_address_id
foreignFields.description: Shipping address for this order. {@link ecommerce_customer_addresses.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status based on item statuses (paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, partially completed).

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Total amount for the entire order, including item costs but excluding tax or shipping fees.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created (after payment succeeded).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order status or details were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: ecommerce_order_items
models.description: Represents individual product variants purchased within orders, including the exact purchase price, quantity, and current status of the item. Tracks the relationship to the parent order, the specific product variant sold, and the lifecycle status from payment through delivery or cancellation. Follows the Snapshot Principle for all status transitions and price records.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The parent order that contains this item. {@link ecommerce_orders.id}

foreignFields.name: variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant sold in this order item. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased of this variant.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at the time of purchase, including any variant-specific price overrides.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the item in the order lifecycle: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was created (time of order placement).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last change to the order item (status update, quantity change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order item was soft-deleted (null for active items).

models.name: ecommerce_shipments
models.description: Shipping packages representing physical deliveries with tracking information. Each shipment is associated with specific order items from the same seller and contains tracking data for customers to monitor delivery status.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_order_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order this shipment belongs to. {@link ecommerce_orders.id.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., 'USPS', 'DHL', 'FedEx').

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Shipping tracking number provided by carrier. Unique per shipment.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current shipping status. Values: 'pending', 'in_progress', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'.

plainFields.name: shipment_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when the shipment was sent by the seller.

plainFields.name: expected_delivery_date
plainFields.description: Estimated date and time when the shipment will be delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: ecommerce_shipment_items
models.description:
Association between order items and their shipment packages.

This junction table records the mapping between order items and shipments. An order item can be part of only one shipment (1:N relationship), and a shipment can contain multiple order items from the same seller.

Junction table ensures proper shipment grouping and ordering during shipping operations.

foreignFields.name: shipment_id
foreignFields.description: The shipment the order item is associated with. {@link ecommerce_shipments.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: The order item associated with this shipment. {@link ecommerce_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the association was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the association was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the association was logically deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_order_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable historical records of order changes for audit and dispute resolution.

This table captures a point-in-time state of each order during modifications, preserving all relevant order fields including status, total price, and customer reference. Snapshots are appended automatically when order state changes occur, allowing complete audit trails of order status transitions throughout the system lifecycle. All historical order states are preserved indefinitely for legal compliance, dispute resolution, and customer support.

Note: This table records the state of the order at the time of modification, with each snapshot corresponding to a specific change event. To get the current order state, use the ecommerce_orders table.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order entity that was modified. {@link ecommerce_orders.id}.

models.name: ecommerce_cancellation_requests
models.description:
Customer requests to cancel specific order items before shipping. Each request requires seller approval or rejection and includes a cancellation reason. This table is managed through order item operations, not directly by customers.

- Each request corresponds to a single order item (order_item_id)
- Status transitions: pending → approved/rejected
- Reason field stores customer-specified cancellation justification (optional)
- Snapshots track state changes via order item lifecycle management

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged order item's {@link ecommerce_order_items.id.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-specified cancellation reason. Optional field for user-provided justification.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current cancellation request status (pending/approved/rejected). Valid values: pending, approved, rejected.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cancellation request was submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cancellation request status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when cancellation request was soft-deleted. Nullable for soft delete.

models.name: ecommerce_refund_requests
models.description:
Customer refund requests for delivered order items within the 7-day window.

This table captures all customer refund requests for items that have been delivered. Each request includes a reason for the refund and its current status (pending, approved, rejected). The refund request process requires that the item has a status of 'delivered' (as per Order Status), and the request must be submitted within 7 days of delivery.

The table has relationships to order items (via order_item_id) and customers (via customer_id), allowing for efficient querying by both customers and sellers. Snapshots are created for refund request status changes, recorded in the ecommerce_refund_request_snapshots table which is part of the Order component.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced order item. {@link ecommerce_order_items.id}

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who requested the refund. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the refund request (text provided by customer).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request (pending, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null means not deleted.

plainFields.name: shop_name

models.name: ecommerce_customer_profiles
models.description:
Customer primary contact information and display name. Stores display name up to 50 characters and validated phone number, with audit timestamps for profile changes.

This table supports customer profile editing requirements where users maintain their own profile data with optional display name and international phone number. The 1:1 relationship with ecommerce_customers ensures consistent session context while preserving profile independence from authentication.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer's primary account ID. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's public display name (max 50 characters).

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: International phone number in E.164 format.

models.name: ecommerce_customer_profile_snapshots
models.description:
Immutable history of customer profile changes with timestamps. Captures all customer profile attributes (display name, phone number) at the time of modification for audit and dispute resolution. Each snapshot links to the original customer profile entity while preserving historical data regardless of subsequent updates.

This table is intentionally denormalized to include all profile fields directly, as per the Snapshot Principle implementation in business requirements. It serves as the audit trail for all profile modifications and is required for dispute resolution between customers and administrators.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_customer_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer profile that was modified.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: The display name of the customer at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: The phone number of the customer at the time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the profile snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for the snapshot (always matches created_at in this context).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Logical deletion timestamp for the snapshot (soft delete support).

models.name: ecommerce_cart_items
models.description:
Active cart items for customers, tracking product variants and quantities with real-time stock validation for purchase intent.

This table manages cart state during checkout process with:
- 1:1 relationship to customers (cart items belong to one customer)
- 1:N relationship to product variants (single variant per cart item)
- Composite unique constraint preventing duplicate item entries per cart
- Full temporal tracking for audit purposes (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at)

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who owns this cart item. {@link ecommerce_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant associated with this cart item. {@link ecommerce_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current quantity of the variant in the cart. Must be at least 1.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was deleted (soft delete).
